name: clean-install a package and verify its autoloads
comment: config clean-install installs ./elpkg.el for real (package-install-file into a sandbox-local elpa/) instead of load-path injection -- autoload cookies, Package-Requires, and byte-compilation are exercised like a user install. Relative paths resolve against this script's directory.

steps.comment: the command exists as an autoload BEFORE the feature was ever required -- the thing load-path injection cannot verify
run it like a user would
invoking the autoload loaded the (byte-compiled) installed copy
it resolves from the sandbox-local package-user-dir, not the source tree
